_comment: Issue #2009, epic #1977 work package D: the prepaid-balance shape.
The billing provider is 'deepseek'; the coding-agent adapter that can
be pointed at it is 'dsh' (matrix column 'deepseek-harness'). They are
not the same thing, and nothing here reads or depends on that adapter.
No live probe has run. The run that wrote this had no DeepSeek account
access, so every claim below is fixture-verified at best: the response
fixture is DeepSeek's own documented example, copied verbatim from
the zero fixture is a shape built from that same schema. Neither is a
capture. No credential resolver, permission or poller ships, so the
route is code-backed only as far as its destination and parser go.
platforms names where that parser and its tests run (pure Go, no
platform-specific code); no resolver or wiring exists on either.

redaction.note: The documented schema has only these two top-level keys. RedactBalanceResponse re-marshals through the same allowlist the parser decodes, so an undocumented field a real response carries never reaches a fixture.

fixtures.name: balance-response-documented
fixtures.note: DeepSeek's documented example response, verbatim (CNY, total 110.00 = granted 10.00 + topped-up 100.00). Not a capture.

fixtures.name: balance-zero
fixtures.note: A zero USD balance with is_available false, built from the documented schema. #2009 §6 row 4 (a real zero-balance account) was not obtainable.

billing_mode.note: The balance response names no product or plan. Whether another route does has not been looked at.

quota_windows.note: Prepaid balance only; no window route has been looked at. Not source-specific-unavailable: nothing reached the route.

balance.note: Currency, the three components and an observed zero survive to the wire (parser_test.go). A multi-currency response is refused rather than summed or truncated, because CreditsSnapshot holds one currency and no real multi-currency response has been seen.

account_identity.note: The documented response carries no account id, so the parser binds the balance to no confirmed account and session.BalanceCovers lets it cover no session. Whether a real response or another route carries one has not been probed.

evidence.note: The allowlist decode, the string-amount parsing, and the refusals.
